u_definition_code_vs_manuscript.CODE_DEFINITION: u_alpha = sqrt( sum_{xyz} Var_members(F) )  [force_std=np.std(F_stack,axis=0,ddof=0); u=sqrt(sum(force_std**2,axis=1))]  — eval_committee_umax_v3final_v2.py:130-131; population variance (1/M); NO 1/3 factor
u_definition_code_vs_manuscript.MANUSCRIPT_DEFINITION: u_i = [ (1/(3M)) sum_m sum_{xyz} (F_ia^(m) - Fbar_ia)^2 ]^{1/2} = sqrt( (1/3) sum_{xyz} Var_members )  — sections/02-methods.tex:71 (M=4)
u_definition_code_vs_manuscript.NORMALIZATION_FACTOR_DIFFERENCE: MANUSCRIPT = CODE / sqrt(3) (~ x0.577). The code SUMS the 3 component variances; the manuscript RMS-AVERAGES over the 3 components. The 1/M is present in both.

But ABSOLUTE u values and any absolute-threshold comparison differ by sqrt(3); the 0.15 code constant is in CODE units.
